notes: All 13 source and 17 target ids are partitioned exactly once.

ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ is headed on *exceeding*, the element the ASV keeps across its renderings of this lexeme (cf. *exceeding abundantly* at Eph 3:20), rather than on the phrase's formal adverbial head *highly*, which rule 17 forbids choosing on that ground alone; the competing head is recorded in the unit's note.
διά takes the discontinuous *for … sake* frame headed on the prepositional word under rule 78, and τό is displaced by the possessive *their* under rule 20.
Both variant units covering s004 and s013 are left as the projection has them (rule 12).
